title: Ascent Overdrive
description: Ascend/descend through the pillar of dimensions! Optional custom world with a realistic mining dimension is linked.
body:
A 1.20.1 fabric modpack about vertically exploring the dimension stack. It goes from the Overworld to the Aether, Earth Orbit, the End, the Moon, Moon Orbit, Mars, Mars Orbit, Glacio, Glacio Orbit, Merury, Mercury Orbit, Venus, Venus Orbit, the Cielands, the Nether, the Void (realistic mining dimension in the custom map), and finally back to the Overworld.

[The custom map](https://www.planetminecraft.com/project/the-column/) is made for the challenge of limiting the world border to 20 chunks and every major plant, block, item, etc is obtainable in it, including modded.

---

### Main Mods:

- Ad Astra
- BetterEnd
- BetterNether
- Create
- El & L's Dyes
- Farmer's Delight
- Immersive Portals
- Nature's Spirit
- Origins
- The Aether
- The Cielands
- Traveler's Backpack
